question: Which exact 3.101.043 LVGL image, cache, style, display and font functions are safe for Resource-Hook targeted resource redirection?
callsite_evidence: lv_image_set_src (0x0c17a2f4) queries header via lv_image_decoder_get_info (0x0c143798) before updating dimensions and invalidating widget area.
lv_obj_tree_walk (0x0c13c690) traverses the registered display screen list (display + 692, count + 720) when root is null, pruning on callback request.
lv_obj_get_style_prop (0x0c1068a8) merges object state at +48 and resolves effective main-part style property value.
lv_obj_set_local_style_prop (0x0c107790) calls lv_obj_refresh_style (0x0c1070ac) with (obj, selector, property) after updating local style property.
lv_cache_drop (0x0c1667dc) unlinks and releases cached entries by key; lv_cache_release (0x0c1666ec) decrements reference count.
_lv_inv_area (0x0c105164) invalidates display area for the default display at 0x2010318c.
lv_display_get_horizontal_resolution (0x0c13cd54) and vertical (0x0c13cd74) return dimensions for display or default display at 0x2010318c.
uikit_font_manager_add_path (0x0c86037c) and remove_path (0x0c860398) access manager at uikit + 28 and manipulate font path list.

provenance.source: Exact 3.101.043 IDB vela_ap.bin.i64 and Capstone 5 instruction review of exact firmware image.
